item.title: Bus Shelter Damage Still Not Fixed, 23rd August
item.description:
I had an email telling me the damage at this bus shelter should have been fixed now. I can report this bus shelter is still not fixed and is still badly damaged. Why is this taking so long to fix? The Glass advert panel is sticking out and its all being held in place by yellow tape! This has been the case for weeks, if not pushing months now.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 36, High Street, Beckenham, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
